name: Tartan by 3M 305 Heavy Duty Clear Carton Sealing Packaging Tape (48mm x 50m)
shortDescription: General-purpose 48mm clear carton sealing tape with bi-axially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) backing and pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive for secure shipping.
overview: Tartan by 3M 305 is a reliable, industrial-grade carton sealing tape engineered for closure of light to medium-weight corrugated shipping boxes exposed to varied temperature and transit conditions. Featuring a tough, biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) film backing coated with an aggressive pressure-sensitive emulsion acrylic adhesive, it delivers high initial shear holding power that bonds tenaciously to recycled corrugate. The acrylic adhesive formulation resists yellowing, UV sunlight degradation, and cold temperature embrittlement, ensuring cartons stay firmly sealed throughout warehousing and export shipping.
keyFeatures: Backed by genuine 3M acrylic adhesive technology for reliable long-term box closure
Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) backing resists edge tearing, splitting, and abrasion
Pressure-sensitive acrylic adhesive adheres instantly to standard and recycled fiberboard cartons
High resistance to UV sunlight, aging, and yellowing during prolonged warehouse storage
Performs consistently across broad temperature swings from freezer rooms to hot shipping containers
Conforms easily to box flaps and contours for a tight, dust-proof perimeter seal
Compatible with standard 48mm / 2-inch handheld pistol-grip tape dispensers

specifications.Color: Crystal Clear Transparent (Also in Tan Brown)

applications: Medium-duty industrial box sealing, carton taping, and carton splicing
E-commerce parcel fulfillment packaging and pallet load identification
Cold storage and refrigerated distribution packaging
General workshop bundling, envelope sealing, and temporary label lamination
